verdict.rationale: Runloop documents its own primitives for background agent work. Axons provide persistent event streams that let agents suspend when idle, wake on demand, recover state and hand off between agents. Tutorials show a suspend/resume workflow that waits for PR feedback and a turn-based agent loop on GitHub PRs, and benchmark jobs run unattended once submitted. However, it is infrastructure for running agents rather than a user-facing automation builder, with no documented schedules or event triggers. Missing for 10: scheduled/cron or trigger-based automation setup, end-to-end documentation of configuring a recurring autonomous automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
